messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "taking with food causes only a small increase in the amount absorbed"
set: ["taking with food causes only a small increase in the amount absorbed", "dissolve omeprazole powder in a small amount of water", "there may be very small difference in amount", "take only the amount prescribed by your doctor", "mix with small amount of applesauce, apple juice, or water", "take once a day in the morning, with or without food", "mix the medicine with soft food", "well absorbed", "take with food", "total amount you take in a day stays the same", "some tablets are made with a shell that is not absorbed or melted in the body", "medicine may be sprinkled into small amount of applesauce", "always with food or always without food", "with or without food", "breast milk in small amounts", "take with food or just after a meal"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
